rationale: The stock gapped down ~5.6% on a severe EPS miss (-120% surprise) and carries a Strong Sell rating, creating downward pressure, but price has recovered from the session low of $44.73 to $47.22 (71.7% of range) and is trading above VWAP ($46.48), suggesting buyers have absorbed much of the selling.
